question: Which of the following pairs of Indian revolutionaries and organisations is CORRECTLY paired?

options.text: Mahadev Govind Ranade – Madras Mahajana Sabha
M Veera Raghavachari – Poona Sarvajanik Sabha

solution:
The correct answer is __**Badruddin Tyabji – Bombay Presidency Association.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Bombay Presidency Association**

 
 
• **Pherozeshah Mehta, Badruddin Tyabji, and K. T. Telang were largely responsible for the formation of the Bombay Presidency Association in 1885. **
 
• Bombay Presidency Association was a body that championed Indian interests and hosted the first meeting of the Indian National Congress in Bombay at the end of 1885.
 
 
 
• **Madras Mahajana Sabha**
 
 
• ​Ramaswami Mudaliar and P. Anandacharlu established the Madras Mahajana Sabha in **1884. **
 
• The first meeting took place on December 29, 1884.
 
• Madras Mahajana Sabha was a Madras Presidency-based Indian nationalist organization.
 
 
 
• **East India Association**
 
 
• ​The East India Association was** founded by Dadabhai Naoroji in 1866,** in collaboration with Indians and retired British officials in London.
 
• It **superseded the London Indian Society.**
 
• It was a platform** for discussing matters and ideas about India, and providing representation for Indians** to the Government.
 
 
 
• **Poona Sarvajanik Sabha**
 
 
• ​The Poona Sarvajanik Sabha was **founded in 1870 at Poona.**
 
• It was founded by Mahadev Govind Ranade, Ganesh Vasudeo Joshi, and S. H. Chiplunkar.
 
 

94:T
